title: Energy-Based Preference Model Offers Better Offline Alignment than the Bradley-Terry Preference Model

live_model.evidence: "Its metrics are win-rates...against GPT-4-turbo across 805 test samples with the judge being GPT-4-turbo itself" (standard AlpacaEval 2.0 protocol description)

prompt.note: Describes the standard AlpacaEval 2.0 evaluation protocol; no prompt specific to querying GPT-4-turbo itself is shown.

claim.metric: none for the live id (GPT-4-turbo is the fixed baseline/judge; the reported win-rates describe the authors' own Energy-Based Preference Model, not GPT-4-turbo)

notes: GPT-4-turbo serves only as AlpacaEval 2.0's fixed baseline generator and default judge for scoring the authors' own trained preference models; no claim in the paper is about GPT-4-turbo's own performance.
